title: PRD: Composite Interaction Bundles (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) and Launch Gates
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Define a product requirements document and gated launch checklist for shipping 'Composite Interaction Bundles' — curated endpoint bundles that pair chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank behaviors for common customer workloads. The goal is to provide a minimal, opinionated surface that ensures behavioral consistency, cost predictability, and clear operational controls for PLG and enterprise customers.
goals: Ship a validated PRD that defines bundle contracts for chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank together
Establish quantitative acceptance gates (quality + performance + telemetry) that a bundle must meet before rollout
Provide a deployment runbook with canary percentages, rollback criteria, and automated smoke tests
Ensure docs and SDK examples are ready for each bundle variant (low-latency, cost-optimized, high-recall)
scope_included: Bundle definitions: behavioral contracts for chat, completions, embeddings, rerank (input/output shapes, error modes)
Acceptance criteria matrix per bundle variant (QA prompt sets, perf targets, token cost bounds)
Canary rollout plan with 3-phase traffic ramp and automated rollback hooks
Console dashboards per-bundle: latency, cost per token, quality regressions, failed requests
SDK and REST examples and a single-page quickstart for each bundle
scope_out_of_scope: Dedicated capacity-only features (Reserved/Dedicated infra specifics are separate workstreams)
Large-scale migration tooling for customers with many legacy endpoints
Model training, fine-tuning UX — only model selection and variant mapping for serving
On-prem specific install instructions (handled by Private team)
acceptance_criteria: Quality: Each bundle variant must pass 95% of regression prompts in the eval suite (per-bundle threshold adjustable but default 95%)
Latency: P95 generation latency <= target for variant (examples: low-latency P95 <= 220ms for short prompts)
Cost: Average token cost per request within specified bound for cost-optimized variant
Reliability: Error rate < 0.5% sustained during a 24h validation window
Observability: Dashboards and tracing links live; alerting configured for SLO breaches
Docs: Quickstart, behavior guide, and SDK snippets published and reviewed
Security: Threat model reviewed; KMS integration and audit logging validated where customer data required
Rollout sign-off: PM, Eng lead, SRE, and Design approval logged in ticket thread
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Dry run: Internal traffic only (engineering + SE tests) for 72h
Phase 1 - Canary: 5% external traffic for 24h with automated validation against smoke suite
Phase 2 - Ramp: 20% for 48h, 50% for 24h contingent on no critical regressions
Phase 3 - Full: 100% with staged regional rollouts (NA -> EU -> APAC) and post-launch evaluation window
Rollback criteria: any P0 customer impact, quality regression > 2% absolute, or latency SLO breach > 30% over baseline triggers rollback
launch_checklist: PRD approved by PM/Design/Eng (document link in artifacts)
Evals: per-bundle prompt sets and automated regression harness green
Perf benchmarks: P95/P99 within targets on canary infra
Telemetry: dashboards, tracing, and alerting configured
Canary automation: traffic routing rule and rollback playbook wired into deployment pipeline
Docs & SDK: quickstart, examples, migration notes, and changelog drafts published
Billing: Pricing tier defined and billing tests validated in sandbox
Support playbook: SE and CS runbook and FAQ created
Legal & Security: basic compliance checklist and security review completed
Go/No-Go meeting scheduled and attendees confirmed
dependencies: ENG-48231 (runtime: variant mapping and kernel selection integration)
ENG-53422 (telemetry: per-route tracing and token cost attribution)
Infra: availability of regional capacity for canary lanes
risks: Quality regressions from model variant substitutions could cause silent consumer impact
Telemetry gaps might prevent fast detection of regressions during canary
Billing edge-cases for composite calls (e.g., simultaneous embedding + generation) could confuse customers
Cross-team alignment risk: Dedicated/private constraints may require later exceptions
metrics: Bundle adoption: number of unique customers using a bundle within 30 days
Quality delta: absolute pass rate change on regression suite pre/post launch
Latency P95 and P99 by bundle variant
Cost per effective request across bundle compositions
SLO breach events and MTTR during initial 14-day window

notes: This PRD aims to strike a balance between opinionated defaults for fast adoption and explicit knobs for advanced users. Priority is to avoid silent behavioral drift: instrumentation and evals are gating criteria. After launch we will run a 14-day 'behavior-guard' evaluation window and iterate on prompt set coverage.
